verdict.rationale: The only denial-related material is a 100% fee refund if USCIS denies the application. It covers the financial consequence, not what a founder should do next. Canada appears among the supported digital nomad visas, and other countries (UK Global Talent, EU Blue Card) are offered. The founder track also bundles free Deel HR and payroll. None of this is framed as an interim or fallback strategy, so the fallback coverage is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit guidance on running the company remotely while a US petition is pending, Canada or other countries positioned as interim options, post-denial next steps (refiling, appeals, alternative visa categories), and any independent corroboration.
